name: Bayside (Long Island estuary)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours), same keys as pnw.json. Indian Island, Riverhead: cooler bent/bluegrass turf, white Long Island bunker sand, the grey-blue-green Peconic estuary, pitch pine and oak at the edge of the pine barrens (tree painters in assets-src/trees_bayside.py). Rough F0-F2: a touch yellower and browner than the fairway greens (developer, 2026-10-19). Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
